name: vital-vscode
description: Language support for Vital (VL): diagnostics, type-aware hover and completion, go-to-definition, find references, inlay hints, formatting, quick-fixes, semantic highlighting, and run.

vital.compilerWasm.description: Path to the self-hosted compiler wasm. Empty = <workspace>/build/vl-compiler.wasm.
vital.compilerWasm.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `vl-compiler.wasm` seed. Overrides every other source. Leave empty to resolve automatically: `$VL_COMPILER_WASM`, the workspace's `build/vl-compiler.wasm`, `vl seed` from an installed CLI, then the copy bundled with the extension.

vital.compilerPath.description: Path to the native `vl` binary used by "Run Current File" (relative paths resolve against the project root). Empty = `vl` on your PATH.
vital.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `vl` executable. Used to fetch the compiler seed (`vl seed`) when no explicit or workspace seed is configured. Defaults to `vl` on `PATH`.

vital.lint.showHeld.description: Show lint findings a committed per-file ratchet baseline already holds, as greyed hints. Off by default: a file at or below its baseline reads as clean.
vital.lint.showHeld.markdownDescription:
Show the lint findings a committed per-file ratchet baseline already holds, as greyed hints rather than hiding them.

The project's ratchets (`scripts/*-budget-baseline.json`) hold a per-file count for codes like `kind-ladder-incomplete` and `sentinel-index-unguarded`, and the gate's rule is that a file's count may only fall. With this off (the default) a file at or below its baseline publishes nothing for that code, and a file ABOVE it publishes every one of that code's findings as a warning prefixed with how far over it is. Turn this on to see the held backlog too.
